about_the_game:
Little Knight 2: Dark Souls of the Past "is the official 3D RPG sequel to the classic" Little Knight ", continuing the passion and adventurous spirit of its predecessor, and creating a broader and more free medieval fantasy world. Players will take on the role of a young knight, growing from an unknown apprentice to a legendary hero renowned throughout the world. The game integrates a deep combat system, equipment reinforcement and drop, rich plot branches, and open world exploration, bringing an immersive medieval adventure experience.

① Hundreds of paranormal points are available for you to challenge, pass levels to obtain talents, and monsters can drop specified ordinary/special/set equipment from paranormal points, fight against wild monsters, and continuously become stronger from a novic

② In the game, fighting monsters, challenging alien points, and exploring maps will all earn loot. Defeating monsters will continuously drop loot and crystals to strengthen equipment, match equipment, and collect set effects, allowing you to receive a large number of rewards in the gam

③ There are dagger/axe/sword/spear/shield/hammer/machete and 4 types of skills in the game for you to match to create different genres. Light/dark/fire/wind skills also interact with each other, such as wind skills summoning a magic helmet at a designated location and releasing the wind skills magic helmet togethe

④ The weapon has a proficiency system, where continuous battles and defeating monsters can earn proficiency in the weapon. After increasing the level of weapon proficiency, players can choose to add points, enhance attack/critical strike/attack speed, etc., which can also play a role in different gameplay style

⑤ After leveling up, you can obtain new equipment creation permissions, create different weapons and equipment, and no longer rely on the store. For example, when you lack advanced weapons such as spears, the store does not sell them and you can create one to match with other weapon

⑥ The plot of the story is the sequel to Little Knight 1. After defeating the source of the plague, Little Knight 1 players enter the abyss inside its body and constantly fight monsters. However, the plague in the real world has not dissipated. Little Knight leaves the abyss and is summoned back to this world by a mysterious force, just like being guided to the ruin

⑦ There are dozens of hidden treasure chests and dozens of testamentary notes of explorable knights in the map of another world. The hidden treasure chests contain powerful special weapons, suit weapons, and gold coins
